title: Pineapple Poffertjes with Caramelized Kissed Dutch Butter
description: A twist on traditional Dutch poffertjes featuring caramelized butter made with kissed Dutch milk and topped with fresh pineapple.

ingredients.name: Large eggs
ingredients.notes: room temperature eggs for better emulsification

instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine Dutch milk, granulated sugar, and unsalted butter. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar dissolves and the butter starts to caramelize.
Increase heat to medium-high and bring the mixture to a simmer. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring frequently, until the caramelized butter turns golden brown.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, flour, salt, and baking powder. Gradually add the caramelized butter to the egg mixture and whisk until smooth.
The batter should still be slightly lumpy. If it's too thick, add a little more Dutch milk. If it's too thin, add a little more flour.
Heat a poffertjes pan or a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Grease the pan with a small amount of unsalted butter.
Using a ladle, pour the batter into the pan and cook until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the poffertjes and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve the poffertjes warm with fresh pineapple and additional caramelized butter, if desired.
